answer_key.audit_retention: Keep application and decision records for 8 years
answer_key.credit_decisioning: Automatic decision from income, credit score and existing obligations, with a manual referral band near the cut-off
answer_key.data_privacy: Capture explicit consent before pulling income and bureau data, and mask the PAN in the app
answer_key.fees_charges: One processing fee deducted at disbursal
answer_key.interest_calculation: Rate comes from a product table by score band, with monthly reducing balance
answer_key.kyc_cdd: Standard tier KYC with PAN and address proof before a decision
answer_key.regulatory_reporting: Report every approved loan to the credit bureau monthly
